newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Weaker Portuguese bonds narrow spread with Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Weaker Portuguese bonds narrow spread with Bunds.

text.p: 1650 GMT - Bonds weakened but not as much as Spain and Germany, so spreads narrowed. Market expected to be illiquid on Friday due to Spanish holiday. *Sept 97 futures down 16 at 111.20 vs Weds close *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.80 vs 102.90. Yld 6.19 vs 6.21 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 67 bps vs 71 bps
